138429.overview: Baseball will take you out to the ball game in the basic sense! The pitcher is able to throw inside and outside curves! An undisputable electronic umpire calls the balls and strikes! The outfielders can play to a batter's faults. A batter can find an opening in the field and aim for it. Except for the hot dogs, peanuts, popcorn and beer this game has it all Triples, doubles, singles and home-runs On-screen digital displays show balls, strikes and score! Full sync-sound action - from the crack of the bat to the cheers of the crowd! This is a two player game.

138440.overview:
Brain Wave is A complicated strategy game using cards and dice It works with game card #3 originally supplied with the system.

It is played on the television screen and also on a game board included with the game.

The aim of the game is to build a "train of thought" across the game board, blocking the other player's path. It is a turn based game that requires clever strategy and tactics to win.

It is one of four additional games released for the Magnavox Odyssey.

138442.overview: Two players use paddles to knock a ball back and forth on a screen; uses an overlay of a basketball court.
